input.sql:
SELECT c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo, COUNT(r.id) AS ruling_count
FROM cards c JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
GROUP BY c.uuid
ORDER BY ruling_count DESC
LIMIT 1
